src.core.statistics.delay_cause.get_mean_cause_list(departure_city: str = None, arrival_city: str = None) → list¶

Retrieve the list of all the delay causes and their frequency of occurrence known for a given city pair.

If no city pair is given, return all the delay causes and their frequency of occurrence over all the network

Parameters:

  • departure_city (str, optional) – the departure city of the railway to analyze

  • None. (Defaults to)

  • arrival_city (str, optional) – the arrival city of the railway to analyze

  • None.

Returns:

the list of all the delay causes and

Return type:

list

their frequency of occurrence known for a given city pair, or over all the french network (depending on the given args). The order of causes is given hereafter :

external infrastructural traffic_management mobile_equipment railstation_management traveler unknown

over all the network

Returns:

float: the frequency of externally caused delay known for a given city pair, or over all the french network (depending on the given args).

src.core.statistics.delay_cause.get_mean_of_unknown_cause(departure_city: str = None, arrival_city: str = None) → float¶

Sometimes, the sum of delay cause frequency given by SNCF does not sum to 100% The unlabeled missing part is said to be from an unknown cause Retrieve the frequency of unkown caused delay known for a given city pair.

If no city pair is given, return the frequency of unkown caused delay over all the network

Args:

departure_city (str, optional): the departure city of the railway to analyze Defaults to None. arrival_city (str, optional): the arrival city of the railway to analyze Defaults to None.

Returns:

float: the frequency of unkown caused delay known for a given city pair, or over all the french network (depending on the given args).
